chunks: Regarding the shrouding of the woman: that which...

Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me of it, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from some of our companions, raising it.

He said: I asked him how the woman is shrouded, so he said: "She is shrouded as the man is shrouded, except that a cloth is tied over her breasts, bringing the two breasts together against the chest, and it is tied to her back. More cotton is placed for her than is placed for men, and the front private part and the rear are stuffed with cotton and hanut, then the cloth is tied firmly over her with a tight fastening."

key_terms.الْحَنُوطِ: the embalming perfume or funerary scent applied to the deceased
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman being prepared for burial
key_terms.تُكَفَّنُ: is shrouded in the burial cloth
key_terms.خِرْقَةً: a piece of cloth used for binding and covering

ai.seo_question: How should a deceased woman be shrouded according to this hadith in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the method of shrouding a deceased woman. It states that her shrouding is like that of a man, with additional measures related to covering the chest and using more cotton and hanut for bodily preparation.
